subject: Monthly pipeline broom + exec deck coordination
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Monthly pipeline broom + exec deck coordination

Hi team,

It’s time for our monthly scrub ahead of next week’s leadership package deadline. I want a tight, practical run: clean stages, confirm commits, and a one-slide exception list for deals that need exec attention. Key asks below.

1) Stage updates: owners update stage and forecast reason in the attached pipeline_snapshot.xlsx by EOD Monday (28 Feb). Keep notes short — 1-2 lines per change.
2) Commits: if you’re asking to commit revenue, add a commit justification in the CommitNotes column and flag the responsible AE.
3) Exec slide: I’ll assemble the exec brief from the template (attached). If you have a critical ask (credits, SLA exceptions, legal blockers), paste it into the ExecAlerts tab in the sheet.

Please reply with any blockers; otherwise proceed. I’m scheduling a 30-min sync Wed to triage exceptions.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2027-02-pipeline_snapshot.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet), exec_brief_template_v2.pptx (pptx, 8 slides)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Feb 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Monthly pipeline broom + exec deck coordination

Thanks — on it. Quick notes:
- I’ll own west accounts and will surface 3 deals that need pricing sync.
- Will update the stage reasons and commit notes by EOD Monday as requested.
- If legal needs to be copied for the two enterprise deals (Tilt Analytics + Meridio) I’ll loop them after updates.

One question: for the exec slide, do you want the short ask + $ impact or a 1-line recommendation only? I can do either, leaning to ask + impact so leadership can triage quickly.

Good approach. A couple of operational clarifications:
- Please use the StageReason picklist (sheet hidden in the workbook) so downstream reports don’t break.
- If you mark something as Commit, put the expected close date and ARR in the CommitDate/CommitARR columns. I’ll validate the math and surface anything that looks inflated.
- For the exec slide, Marissa — include ask + impact. Leadership prefers "ask, impact, risk" in three bullets.

I’ll join the Wed sync and bring consolidated numbers from finance. Also tagging Laura to confirm whether we need CFO sign-off for any >$500k ARR commit asks.

Thanks for driving this. A couple quick confirmations from finance leadership:
- CFO sign-off required for any net-new commit > $500k ARR or renewal with material concession.
- For asks that request credits or SLA exceptions, include the proposed mitigation and a short customer health note (one sentence).

I’ll review the assembled exec slide once Markus drops it in the Drive folder — aim to have finance comments back by EOD Friday.
